title: The pseudo-Riemannian spectral zeta function density on scattering manifolds
summary: We study spectral zeta densities associated with complex powers of principally scalar Laplace-type operators on pseudo-Riemannian scattering spaces of mixed signature and arbitrary dimension. The construction extends, beyond the even-dimensional Lorentzian case, the local analysis of Feynman complex powers developed by Dang and Wrochna. Namely, for $\varepsilon > 0$, we consider complex powers $(P\pm i\varepsilon)^{-α}$ and prove that the diagonal trace densities admit meromorphic continuation.
